# Milton Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Milton, Wellington County, Milton Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 878-2164  |  Email: contact@miltonheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://miltonheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Milton, Guelph, Georgetown, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood
